public_domain_us.label: Public domain (US)
public_domain_us.desc: Published before 1931, or otherwise shown to be in the US public domain, with written evidence. It may not be public domain in your country.

open_license.label: Open license
open_license.desc: Released under an open license (Creative Commons or CC0). The license is linked in the evidence and its terms apply.

permission_granted.label: Permission granted
permission_granted.desc: The rights holder gave written permission. The date of the permission is in the evidence.

link_only.label: Link only
link_only.desc: In copyright or restricted. We link to the record’s book page on isidore.co, never to its files.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.desc: Not yet reviewed, or the evidence is not strong enough. Treated as link only until a person checks it.

U1b.text: A 1931–63 catalog year with a foreign or unknown publisher. Foreign works were restored by the URAA (17 USC 104A) unless public domain at home on 1 January 1996.

U1c.text: A 1931–63 catalog year, but the file has an ISBN, so it is probably a later reprint. Which edition was scanned is not known.

U2.text: No publication year and no usable author dates.

U2a.text: No publication year. The author died before 1931, but the edition or translation has not been checked.

U3.text: The catalog year is the date the work was written, not the date of this edition. The edition or translation could be old (free) or modern (protected).

U4.text: The author died before 1931, but this is a 1964 or later edition, which may carry a copyrighted translation, edition, or notes.

L1.text: Catalog year 1978 or later: presumed in copyright unless openly licensed or permission is given. (Catalog years are sometimes digital release dates; ask us to recheck.)

L2.text: Catalog year 1964–77: renewal was automatic, so presumed in copyright for 95 years unless published without a notice.

L3.text: No year, but the file has an ISBN (a post-1970 edition): presumed in copyright.

L4.text: A papal, curial, conciliar, or bishops’ conference text in a post-1930 or undated edition: rights are reserved by LEV or the USCCB. Read it at the official source.

L5.text: No year, and the author is living or died in 1956 or later: presumed in copyright.

L6.text: A 1931–63 work with a matching copyright renewal in the NYPL CCE renewals data: protected for 95 years from publication.
